purpose: Focused instrumental melody candidate. Backing and mixer held fixed; quality is not established by these metrics.
baseline: Saved after compositions from fdf81be, reported at e8b5124; Audiobox rescored before this change, CLAP baseline reused after hash verification.
design: Nine presets x seeds 101/103; same full-length 48 kHz stereo float WAV rendering, no tail or gain normalization. Fixed written backing, effects and performance transforms. Candidate changes instrumental melody notes and recipe digest only. Singer writer untouched.

audiobox.scoring: Existing aesthetics.py score function unchanged; model handles 10-second windows across complete WAV, duration-weighted final partial window.

clap_preprocessing.normalization: none; native CLAP clips to [-1,1] and quantizes to int16
clap_preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
clap_preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt cosines

timing_definition: Descriptive written-note timing only. Not human catchiness, rendered silence, or musical quality. Fixed 3/4 and 4/4 benchmark; active recipe lead clips; unrecipe'd endings excluded. Terminal rests at clip ends only. Fractions averaged equally per project.

listening_excerpts.processing: Same first-chorus slice with a 5 ms linear fade at each edge; no gain normalization. These excerpts are for listening only, not model evaluation.
